official.$description: The National Flag and Armorial Ensigns Act prescribes six equal horizontal bands in black, yellow, red, black, yellow and red with a central white disc and crested crane; the Office of the Vice President describes the same design. Digital colour values are screen equivalents of the Republic of Uganda Brand Book references (Pantone 109C yellow, 032C red and black), not RGB values stated in the Act. Sources: [National Flag and Armorial Ensigns Act](https://ulii.org/en/akn/ug/act/ord/1962/64/eng%402023-12-31), [Office of the Vice President: National Symbols](https://www.vicepresident.go.ug/national-symbols/), [Republic of Uganda Brand Book](https://cdnc.heyzine.com/files/uploaded/v2/0a331649839777f64d4078806fcd619429e97589.pdf).
